pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} in a warm, everyday home moment — making coffee, reading, ordinary morning charm.
pages.textTemplate:
Once upon an ordinary morning, at home, at ease,
Was {{SUBJECT_NAME}} — doing exactly as they please.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} going about their day, a small idiosyncratic habit visible.
pages.textTemplate:
Now, {{FROM_NAME}} could tell you a thousand small things,
About the particular joy that {{SUBJECT_NAME}} brings.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} paused mid-moment, about to do something characteristic and charming.
pages.textTemplate:
But there's one story {{FROM_NAME}} tells again and again —
The one that explains, more than most, exactly when...

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} heading out the door or into a scene, purposeful and warm.
pages.textTemplate:
Because {{SUBJECT_NAME}} has a way of turning any old day,
Into something worth telling, in their own particular way.

pages.sceneDescription: Friends or family greeting {{SUBJECT_NAME}} warmly.
pages.textTemplate:
Everyone who meets them ends up feeling the same —
That the world's a little brighter since {{SUBJECT_NAME}} came.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} pausing, thoughtful, noticing something small and lovely.
pages.textTemplate:
{{FROM_NAME}} noticed it early — that particular knack,
For noticing beauty that others might overlook, or lack.

pages.sceneDescription: A signature charming quirk moment in full swing.
pages.textTemplate:
Because nobody does it quite like {{SUBJECT_NAME}} does —
And that's exactly why this story deserves a round of applause.

pages.sceneDescription: The warm ripple effect of the quirk — laughter, closeness.
pages.textTemplate:
It wasn't perfect, it wasn't neat,
But it was {{SUBJECT_NAME}}'s most lovable feat.

pages.sceneDescription: Friends gathered, laughing fondly, retelling the moment.
pages.textTemplate:
'That's so them!' the whole room cried,
With so much love, and so much pride.

pages.sceneDescription: A small everyday hiccup — a mix-up, a mishap.
pages.textTemplate:
Then — a wobble! A moment gone slightly wrong!
The kind that becomes a favourite story before long.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} handling the mishap with their particular grace or humour.
pages.textTemplate:
But {{SUBJECT_NAME}} handled it their own particular way,
Turning a mishap into the best part of the day.

pages.sceneDescription: A second, distinct signature quirk moment.
pages.textTemplate:
And just when you'd think the story had run its course,
One more {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-ism came, right from the source.

pages.sceneDescription: The warmth spreading — a shared laugh, a tender look.
pages.textTemplate:
It turned an ordinary evening quite delightfully strange,
In the best possible, {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-shaped kind of way.

pages.sceneDescription: A quiet tender moment — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} and {{FROM_NAME}} sitting close, soft light.
pages.textTemplate:
For just one moment, the whole world went quiet,
And there they sat, together, past the riot.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} setting off on a small adventure or outing.
pages.textTemplate:
Then up they got, with a brand new plan,
The best kind of love always outruns a nap.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} out in a bigger scene — a walk, a trip, an outing.
pages.textTemplate:
Further and further, hand in hand,
To see how much love one day could hold, unplanned.

pages.sceneDescription: A third signature quirk moment, in the bigger outing setting.
pages.textTemplate:
And it wouldn't be a proper {{SUBJECT_NAME}} story, not one bit,
Without one more quirk to go with it.

pages.sceneDescription: A joyful triumphant beat — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} laughing, mid-moment.
pages.textTemplate:
It was silly, it was warm, it was entirely their own —
A {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-sized moment, for the whole world to be shown.

pages.sceneDescription: Golden hour, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} and {{FROM_NAME}} together, anticipation of something meaningful.
pages.textTemplate:
As the sun leaned low and the sky turned gold,
The very best part of their story was about to unfold.

pages.sceneDescription: The emotional high point — the real story's payoff, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} and {{FROM_NAME}} together.
pages.textTemplate:
Because the very best love stories aren't the loud, big kind —
They're the small true moments that stay in your mind.

pages.sceneDescription: A joyful celebratory scene — friends or family, warmth all around.
pages.textTemplate:
Everyone smiled — the whole room, it seemed! —
For a story better than anyone had dreamed.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} and {{FROM_NAME}} heading home together under an evening sky.
pages.textTemplate:
And as the stars blinked on, one by one by one,
They headed home together — the day's adventure done.

pages.sceneDescription: A cosy evening in — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} settled in, content, warm light.
pages.textTemplate:
Curled up together, the evening winding down,
{{FROM_NAME}} thought: what a wonderful person I've found.

pages.sceneDescription: Final tender image — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} peaceful, warm, loved.
pages.textTemplate:
Because there's only one {{SUBJECT_NAME}} in the whole wide world,
And every quirk and story is a flag they've unfurled.
Here's to you, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} — this book, this life, this view,
{{FROM_NAME}} is endlessly grateful it's you.
